one_line: Web scraping/crawling API that turns any website into LLM-ready markdown or structured data.
auth_notes: API key (fc-...) passed as 'Authorization: Bearer $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY'; first scrape works without a key at low rate limits
self_serve_notes: Free tier with a free account and free API key ('Create a free account for direct API access and higher limits'); paid plans raise rate limits and credits

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API (api.firecrawl.dev/v2) covering scrape, crawl, map, search, interact, parse, extract; plus async jobs and webhooks; full API reference published
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks documented for async event delivery of crawl/scrape results

existing_mcp.note: Official Firecrawl MCP Server confirmed in fetched text ('MCP Server: Connect Firecrawl to any AI tool via the Model Context Protocol'); also open-source self-hostable

evidence.note: fetched text confirms API key auth, free tier, REST endpoints, webhooks and official MCP server

agent_notes: Official MCP server exists; easy free-tier start.
